episode.title: "The Lambo Houdini Kid"
episode.description: "An 18-year-old bought a Lamborghini from a $500 trading account. Or did he?"

beats.name: THE HOOK
beats.vo: An 18-year-old bought a Lamborghini from a $500 trading account.

beats.name: VIRAL SCALE
beats.vo: Twenty five million views. TikTok, Instagram, Reddit — the same video on every timeline on Earth, in days.

beats.name: THE MEME SPREADS
beats.vo: From Los Angeles to Tokyo, the story spread in days. But nobody can prove a single dollar is real — so how did a teen turn $500 into five million?
beats.text: FROM ONE LAPTOP TO EVERY TIMELINE ON EARTH

beats.name: THE MONEY MACHINE
beats.vo: The claim: $500, turned into five million dollars through trading. Five million. In a car. Allegedly.

beats.name: THE BUSINESS MODEL
beats.vo: Here's the machine. Followers give attention. Feeds spread the hype. Trading apps make it effortless. And the story becomes the brand — the kid with the supercar.

beats.name: VIRAL GROWTH
beats.vo: Attention grew like a chart — a few million views, then tens of millions. But hype is not proof. Faith paid the bills, not receipts.

beats.name: THE REAL LESSON
beats.vo: So what's the real lesson? Hype is not a business. Verify before you trade. And a Lamborghini is never a strategy — it's a story the whole world chose to believe.
